Celtics 98Raptors 93

Tatum's free throws finish a 22-point comeback

Final · Wed, Nov 11 · Toronto

Boston beat Toronto 98–93, a 5-point road win. The Celtics move to 10–2; the Raptors fall to 5–6.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · How it went

Won the fourth quarter 23–13

Down 5 after three quarters, the Celtics won the fourth quarter 23–13 to win 98–93.

2 of 5 · Who carried it

Tatum: 24 points, 10 of 12 at the line

Scored the first 10 of a 16–0 run, then the go-ahead free throws.

3 of 5 · The Raptors’ side

From the Raptors’ side.

Led by 5 after three quarters, then lost the fourth 13–23.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it at the line and in the fourth

Free throws made 24–13; blocks 10–4. Boston held Toronto to 13 in the fourth.

5 of 5 · What it meant

Celtics 98, Raptors 93.

The Celtics move to 10–2, 1st in the East. The Raptors fall to 5–7, 8th in the East.
